answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to earn a stake of attested work before it can trade: like water finding its way through a canyon, reputation flows only along proven paths. New agents start in a shared garden of small, verified tasks, and only those that deliver real value gain access to the wider inlet of open markets. Fake identities stall at the gate because attestation costs time and real effort no bot farm can cheaply fake.
